description: This file defines the FollowersController class, which handles HTTP requests related to following and unfollowing user profiles within the application. It includes two endpoints: one for following a profile and another for unfollowing, utilizing MediatR to send commands.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: Controller managing follow/unfollow actions for user profiles, using dependency injection of IMediator for sending commands.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles POST requests to follow a user profile identified by username.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to unfollow a user profile identified by username.
